header.title: Health history
header.subtitle: Medical records, symptom log and long-term trends across the mission.
header.syncNote: Synced from the crew medical station · 2 h ago

trends.label: Bone mineral density
trends.note: Countermeasure exercise is slowing the loss; still above the mission action limit of -2%.

trends.label: Lean muscle mass
trends.note: Quadriceps respond slower than calves to the ARED prescription — plan adjusted on day 145.

trends.label: Resting heart rate
trends.note: Steady decline reflecting cardiovascular deconditioning — controlled by daily cardio.

trends.label: Average sleep
trends.note: Dip after the day 140 particle event alert; recovering with adjusted light schedule.

categories.name: Immunity
categories.blurb: Defenses, latent virus screening and vaccination status.

records.title: Immune panel
records.detail: White cell count within flight norms. T-cell activity stable at 96% of pre-flight response.

records.title: Latent virus screening
records.detail: No reactivation of latent Epstein-Barr virus. Saliva sample negative.

categories.name: Laboratory
categories.blurb: Blood, urine and metabolic samples from the medical station.

records.title: Blood draw — metabolism
records.detail: Glucose, lipids and electrolytes in range. Hemoglobin 14.1 g/dL.

records.title: Urinalysis
records.detail: Hydration markers good. Calcium excretion slightly elevated — expected in microgravity.

categories.name: Cardiovascular
categories.blurb: Heart function, rhythm and aerobic capacity.

records.title: Echo & ECG review
records.detail: Rhythm normal, ejection fraction 58%. Cardiac muscle mass -4% vs. pre-flight baseline.

records.title: VO2 max test
records.detail: 88% of pre-flight value, maintained by daily ARED and treadmill sessions.

categories.name: Bone density
categories.blurb: DEXA scans of load-bearing bones and spine.

records.title: DEXA — femoral neck
records.detail: 1.18 g/cm², -1.2% vs. pre-flight. Loss rate slowing to 0.4% per quarter.

records.title: Spinal scan
records.detail: Lumbar BMD -1.8%. Intervertebral discs slightly over-hydrated, as expected in orbit.

records.title: MRI — thigh volume
records.detail: Thigh MRI: quadriceps -8.4%, calves -5.1% vs. pre-flight volume.

records.title: Strength battery
records.detail: Knee extension at 88% of baseline. Grip strength nominal.

records.title: Vision check (SANS)
records.detail: Slight far-vision blur noted; optic disc flat. Weekly monitoring continues.

records.title: Cognitive test battery
records.detail: Reaction time and spatial memory within 5% of pre-flight results.

symptoms.name: Headache
symptoms.note: Resolved after fluid salts and rest.

symptoms.name: Lower back stiffness
symptoms.note: Eases after the morning ARED session.

symptoms.name: Short sleep
symptoms.note: Followed the solar particle event alert on day 140.

timeline.title: Pre-flight baseline
timeline.detail: Full medical, dental and psychological baseline completed before launch.

timeline.title: Launch & docking
timeline.detail: Docked with the space station — mission day 1.

timeline.title: First in-flight scan
timeline.detail: First in-flight body scan; all systems nominal.

timeline.title: Radi-N2 online
timeline.detail: Neutron radiation detector activated at the service window.

timeline.title: Vision change noted
timeline.detail: Mild far-vision blur recorded; weekly SANS checks scheduled.

timeline.title: Bone & muscle scan
timeline.detail: Femur and lumbar scans compared against pre-flight baseline.

timeline.title: Today
timeline.detail: Mission day 148. Records up to date, no open alerts.
